hero.title: Software is global on day one. Localization should be too.
hero.lead: We're a team of localization managers, linguists and engineers who spent years watching great products launch in one language and apologise in the rest.

story.title: Why we started
paragraphs: In 2019, our founders were running localization for a fast-growing SaaS company. Engineering shipped every week; translations shipped every quarter. The gap was filled with spreadsheets, exported files and late-night messages to vendors in six time zones.

Lingrove started as an internal tool that treated translations like code: versioned, reviewed and merged through pull requests. Other teams asked to use it. Today it powers localization for more than 400 software companies.

values.title: Meaning over words
values.body: A correct translation that confuses the reader is still a bug. We build for clarity in every market.

values.title: Quiet tools
values.body: The best infrastructure disappears into the workflow. We measure success by how little our customers have to think about us.

values.title: Earned trust
values.body: Our customers hand us their unreleased product. We treat security and privacy as features, not paperwork.
